info.title: d2e
info.description: CLI to convert JetBrains .DotSettings files (Rider / ReSharper) to .editorconfig.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the result here. An existing file is merged into, never replaced wholesale. [Default: null]

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file instead of merging into it.

options.name: --no-root
options.description: Omit "root = true" from a newly created file.

options.name: --no-header
options.description: Omit the "generated by" header comment from a newly created file.

options.name: --show-skipped
options.description: List every entry that could not be converted.
